narrative.overview:
This is a formal briefing a GitHub account team can put in front of a customer without editing. Every surface borrows from the GitHub Copilot Technical Update Briefing deck and the 2026 GitHub presentation template: near-black brand slides, a single GitHub Green accent, Mona Sans set large and without tracking, square cards, hairline rules, and the white Invertocat in a boxed footer. The web chrome around the deck is a quiet frame. It should never outshine the slides.

Density follows a presenter's needs. Slides are fixed 1280×720 canvases scaled to fit, so composition is deliberate and identical on screen, in PDF and in PowerPoint. Chapters group slides the way a presenter would talk through them: overview, then one chapter per product area, then events and close. Motion is a presenter's tool: content builds in the order a speaker would reveal it, then holds still.

Trust is the product. Every sentence on a slide carries a superscript citation that links to the page it came from, and nothing is stated without a working source. Visual decisions that would weaken that, such as decorative imagery, unsourced numbers or invented charts, are out.
keyCharacteristics: Dark brand slides (`#101411`), one green accent, and neutral surfaces for about 90% of every screen.
Mona Sans with the Display optical size (`opsz` 72) for headlines and no letter-spacing anywhere.
Square slide geometry, hairline borders and no drop shadows inside slides.
Section color is used only as a signal: icons, a 4px inset top rule or a pill outline, never as a fill behind text.
Superscript, linked citations on every claim.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: GitHub Green is the only accent that fills a control. Section colors may outline, rule or tint an icon, but never fill a button or sit behind body text.

rules.name: The Brand Slide Rule
rules.body: Brand slides (cover, agenda, overview, highlights, dividers and closing) are always dark, whatever the app theme. The app theme changes only the frame around them.

rules.name: The No-Tracking Rule
rules.body: `letter-spacing` is never set, in keeping with the GitHub brand. Hierarchy comes from size, weight and optical size.

rules.name: The Numerals Rule
rules.body: Counts, dates, KPIs and slide numbers use Mona Sans Mono or `tabular-nums` so columns and counters don't jitter while they animate.

rules.name: The Flat Slide Rule
rules.body: Nothing on a slide floats. If an element needs emphasis, give it size, weight or the green accent, never a shadow.

dos: Do keep brand slides on Brand Black (#101411) with Paper text, in both app themes.
Do cite every sentence with a superscript link to the page it came from.
Do use the Display optical size (`"opsz" 72`) for slide titles of 56px and larger.
Do use Mona Sans Mono or `tabular-nums` for counts, dates and slide numbers.
Do animate only `transform` and `opacity`, with ease-out curves, and fall back to an opacity-only change under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Do group slides into chapters that match the deck sections: Overview, product areas, Events, Close.
donts: Don't fill buttons, backgrounds or text blocks with section colors. Use them for icons, a 4px top rule or an outline.
Don't round slide cards or add drop shadows inside slides.
Don't use colored `border-left` stripes wider than 1px as a status marker.
Don't animate from `scale(0)` or use ease-in for entrances. Start at 0.96 or higher, or rise 8–16px.
Don't recolor or outline the Invertocat. It appears only in white on dark or black on light.
Don't show a statement, number or chart that has no working source link.
